facts.fact: The health ministry's monitoring and evaluation plan for the PNDS 2023-2027, validated on 6 October 2023, requires each health facility to key its validated monthly or quarterly activity report (RMA/RTA) into DHIS2 before the 5th of the following month, the facility's SNIS respondent doing the entry, and to send the paper copy to the prefectoral health directorate (DPS) by the same date; it also sets the 20th as the deadline at DPS level for the reports to be entered in DHIS2.

The plan (validated 6 October 2023) names the facilities producing and keying SNIS reports as the peripheral care units (USP), where the facility head is the SNIS respondent, and the CHP, CHR and CHU hospitals, where a data or statistics officer is; it says the CHR and CHU data are taken into account by the health district in whose area they sit.

The health ministry's plan gives the SNIS report completeness rate as 96.5% in 2021, defined as the number of health facilities that keyed a complete SNIS report into DHIS2 over the total number of health facilities due to key SNIS reports, sourced to the health statistics yearbook; it prints the rate only, without the counts, covers all facilities and not primary clinics alone, notes duplicate entries in hospital data as a known bias, and gives timeliness of 77.3% in 2021.

The plan (validated 6 October 2023) states that DHIS2 is the SNIS platform chosen by the health ministry, that coordination of the SNIS is the responsibility of the ministry's Direction du Système National d'Information Sanitaire et de l'Informatique (DSNISI), and that the national SNIS pool maintains and updates DHIS2.

The monitoring and evaluation plan of the PNDS 2023-2027, validated on 6 October 2023, names DHIS2 as the SNIS platform, sets yearly targets to 2027 for SNIS completeness (97.2% in 2023 to 100% in 2027), timeliness (78.8% to 85%) and data quality audits, and schedules and costs an annual SNIS review for each year from 2023 to 2027.

The plan (validated 6 October 2023) names no budget line for the SNIS or DHIS2; it lists seeking partners to finance the SNIS among the duties of the national and regional SNIS pools and names mobilising the resources needed for optimal use of DHIS2 as a requirement of the central directorates.
